|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Din Djarin's Modified N-1]] (version 1 of 2). The image here is the Players Committee repository image of the original state. The current text is [[Din Djarin's Modified N-1 (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).
* '''Original''' (this page): Players Committee card image in the repository revision dated 7 August 2025<ref name="ht-7821822">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual25-Light/large/dindjarinsmodifiedn1.gif</code> in the repository revision dated 7 August 2025: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/782182256b44863b5363404bf248c0502ee71360/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Light/large/dindjarinsmodifiedn1.gif holotable commit 7821822] “Fixing case and making gifs” (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “May add 1 pilot and Grogu as a passenger. Din deploys -1 aboard. While Din piloting, immune to attrition &lt; 5 and, once per game, may use 3 Force to cancel a battle just initiated here.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Din Djarin's Modified N-1 (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 25 release sheet<ref name="sheet25-20250810">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF, 10 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, August 2025”; file created 10 August 2025). The printed footer identifies the August 2025 edition; the PDF creation date is file metadata.</ref>, page 10, file created 10 August 2025: “May add 1 pilot and Grogu as a passenger. Din deploys -1 aboard. While Din piloting, immune to attrition &lt; 5 and, once per game, may use 3 Force to cancel a battle just initiated here.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Din Djarin's Modified N-1]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Din Djarin's Modified N-1]] (repository revision 7 August 2025) as a printable slip under the label “•Din Djarin’s Modified N-1”; the printed face matches the image in artwork, wording and visible printed details; the sheet omits the top padding and uses different image encoding. A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
